name: Drink the Ocean
description: Drink down the sea, uncover seabed treasure, upgrade your straw, and explore an island alone or with friends in this browser incremental game.

faq.question: Where can I play the Mana version of Drink the Ocean?
faq.answer: Open mana.gs/drink-the-ocean and select Play Now. Mana runs the game in a desktop browser without requiring a download.

faq.question: Can I play Drink the Ocean with friends?
faq.answer: Yes. The Mana version supports solo play or co-op with 1–4 players. Look for the Multiplayer option on the game menu.

faq.question: Do I need a Mana account to play?
faq.answer: No. Mana allows guest play. Registering an account is optional.

faq.question: Does Drink the Ocean work on phones?
faq.answer: Mana currently lists the game for desktop browsers with keyboard and mouse, not mobile touch controls.

faq.question: How do I get better straws?
faq.answer: As the sea level falls, explore the exposed seabed for treasure. Sell your finds to the island merchant to buy more powerful straws.

faq.question: Why does another Drink the Ocean guide mention salt presses or a Sky Duck?
faq.answer: That guide describes a different game distributed through Playgama. This page covers the Mana version with treasure, a merchant, and solo or co-op play.
